metadata.article_title: Right of third person claiming goods bailed.

article.title: Right of third person claiming goods bailed.
article.content:
167Right of third person claiming goods bailed.

Section 167  ·  Chapter IX  ·  page 41 of the Act
If a person, other than the bailor, claims goods bailed he may apply to the Court to stop the delivery of the goods to the bailor, and to decide the title to the goods.
